quarterly_data.signal: Financial consideration stated with the EU approval of Enhertu as monotherapy for previously treated unresectable or metastatic HER2-positive (IHC 3+) solid tumours (the tumour-agnostic indication): following this approval an amount of $25 million is due from AstraZeneca to Daiichi Sankyo as a milestone payment; sales of Enhertu in most EU territories are recognised by Daiichi Sankyo (the financial arrangements are set out in the March 2019 collaboration agreement).
quarterly_data.figure: $25 million milestone payment due from AstraZeneca to Daiichi Sankyo
